text.p: Former England international striker Mark Hateley took over on Tuesday as player-manager of third division Hull City.
Hateley, 35, whose career has encompassed a variety of clubs including AC Milan, Monaco and Glasgow Rangers, announced the move at a news conference at his new club.
He left Glasgow Rangers at the end of last season and now replaces dismissed Hull manager Terry Dolan, who lost his job on Monday.
Struggling Hull were recently bought by British former Davis Cup tennis player David Lloyd and his business partner and club chairman Tim Wilby.
